{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 3-5 day true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, delay peak forecast by 1-2 days to account for lagged market reaction.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 10% above recent 15-day high to prevent overshoot after sharp price increases.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 3-5% to capture sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "If true outcome is consistently higher than forecast over 3 consecutive days, shift forecast mean toward true outcome’s recent path, not just last value."
  ]
}
